seo_title: About Us & Our Team | Every Human Support Services
seo_description: Meet the family owned team at Every Human Support Services, supporting NDIS participants and older Australians in Wollongong, Ulladulla, Logan and the Gold Coast.
intro: Every Human is a family owned and operated business delivering personalised, ethical support to people living with disability, illness or age-related challenges.
story_text: We started Every Human because we believe everyone deserves support that feels personal. The diversity of our team means we can choose the right person to suit your lifestyle, personality and needs. We work with you and your support network to meet your goals and get the most out of your funding, while doing things the right way, including reducing waste and recycling where we can.
child_safe: We partner with children and their families to support a meaningful and fulfilling life. We follow the Child Safe Scheme and the National Principles for Child Safe Organisations, along with all our legal and regulatory obligations.
office_intro: The people who answer your calls, build your rosters and keep everything running smoothly.
support_intro: The people who'll be by your side, at home and out in the community.

video_description: A short montage of clients and support workers out and about together, ending with the Every Human logo and contact details.
